author: nicolasallasia
body:
With the ring you get only the upper two tiers of monsters (your tier and one less) to spawn.
For example a T10 character with the ring will only have t10 and t9 to spawn in the world. I don't know if the berserker enemy increase is from the ring or the "forced" spawn of enemies, but it's like having an affinity candle+some more bers.

body: I think it increases the berserk enemy spawn rate
